decisions.reason: As a specialized extension of the firm's coatings and spraying portfolio, it likely remains on the market, though its more niche application and only limited website prominence raise the risk somewhat.
This product is very close to the firm's established core business and had its own product page, so a medium-sized German machinery firm would usually continue backing it after launch.

The transfer pump fits well with the firm's material handling systems and broad installed base, but its lower visibility on the website suggests a slightly higher chance of rationalization than the strongest launches.
Fire protection flow monitoring builds on the existing offer and supports the firm's move toward more digital and interoperable customer solutions, making continuation likely.
